assumptions_named.entry: Backout: recoverable files and Db2 undone, RECOVERY(NONE) files kept
READ ... INTO LENGTH: in-out, truncation and LENGERR; a VSAM file's LENGTH need not equal its record length; LENGERR on READ UPDATE refused
Terminal RECEIVE (INTO / SET, LENGTH, MAXLENGTH, NOTRUNCATE; LENGERR, EOC on an LUTYPE2 terminal) and SEND CONTROL

Interval control on the det port: START (INTERVAL / TIME / AFTER / AT, TERMID, REQID, PROTECT, FROM, RTRANSID / RTERMID / QUEUE), RETRIEVE (INTO / LENGTH, the data options, ENVDEFERR), CANCEL REQID, RUN TRANSID CHILD [CHANNEL], FETCH ANY / CHILD NOSUSPEND (#4884); TIME RESP2 and the order of out-of-range checks assumed; a FETCH that waits, FREE CHILD, START CHANNEL, RETRIEVE SET / WAIT refused
assumptions_named.status: ASSUMED (REFUSED where IBM is silent); FETCH DIFFERS

assumptions_named.entry: ASSIGN on the det port: STARTCODE (TD / S / SD), USERID (the default user), FACILITY / SCRNHT / SCRNWD (INVREQ RESP2 5 without a terminal) from facts the harness states; no data area written when ASSIGN raises INVREQ; OPID, NETNAME, TERMCODE, FCI, the other screen sizes, work-area lengths and the rest refused
assumptions_named.status: ASSUMED (REFUSED where the harness cannot decide)

assumptions_named.entry: SEND TEXT on the det port and the stub: TERMINAL accepted as the default output disposition (the principal facility; the event is that of SEND TEXT without it); ACCUM, PAGING, SET, REQID, HEADER, TRAILER, JUSTIFY / JUSFIRST / JUSLAST, the printer, partition and LDC options, MSR, FMHPARM, DEFAULT / ALTERNATE refused
assumptions_named.status: MATCHED (REFUSED where the region cannot decide)

assumptions_named.entry: READ GTEQ / GENERIC on a KSDS: the first record whose key (or its first KEYLENGTH bytes) equals RIDFLD's or, with GTEQ, is greater, in the browse's key order (D1); NOTFND RESP2 80; READ UPDATE holds the record found; RIDFLD not updated; #4771: on a file named at run time the full key is that file's (looked up then), and DELETE GENERIC deletes every record with the generic key (NOTFND RESP2 80 when none); a GENERIC KEYLENGTH not shorter than the key or not above zero, a non-constant KEYLENGTH and a RIDFLD shorter than the key searched refused
assumptions_named.status: ASSUMED (REFUSED where IBM is silent or the layout decides)

assumptions_named.entry: RETURN TRANSID ... IMMEDIATE: the task of TRANSID attached at once with the COMMAREA, ahead of any terminal input and any START request, the terminal's next operator step left alone; its EIBAID is not stated by IBM (the crucible runner gives none and a case never reads it), its STARTCODE TD; INVREQ RESP2 1 (no terminal), INVREQ RESP2 2 (below the highest level), LENGERR RESP2 11 return to the program; LINK ... SYNCONRETURN accepted and ignored (IBM: "ignored if the link is local"); IMMEDIATE without TRANSID, and both INVREQs at once (no terminal below level 1), refused
assumptions_named.status: ASSUMED (the STARTCODE; REFUSED where IBM is silent)

assumptions_named.entry: DEFINE COUNTER (COUNTER / POOL / VALUE; none: the initial value zero; a counter that exists: INVREQ RESP2 202; a pool or counter name outside IBM's characters: INVREQ RESP2 403 / 404) and DELETE COUNTER (a counter that is not there: INVREQ RESP2 201; a pool outside IBM's characters: 403); GET COUNTER and QUERY COUNTER answer INVREQ RESP2 201 for a counter that is not there (GET COUNTER answered NOTFND before: IBM lists none) and 403 / 404 for a bad pool / name; MINIMUM / MAXIMUM / NOSUSPEND / DCOUNTER, a VALUE below zero and a counter name of blanks refused

INQUIRE URIMAP's browse (START / NEXT / END with URIMAP, PATH, TRANSACTION: END RESP2 2 past the last definition, ILLOGIC RESP2 1 for a START while one is open; the installed definitions and their order are stated by whoever runs the task; a short value is padded with blanks; the areas are left alone on any condition other than NORMAL) and WRITE OPERATOR (TEXT only; recorded as a WRITE-OPERATOR event); the direct form INQUIRE URIMAP(name) (modelled since #4768, X34), every other URIMAP attribute, a NEXT / END with no browse, and a console text IBM reformats (DFHnnnn / DFHaannnn, or over 113 characters) refused

DOCUMENT CREATE (DOCTOKEN; none, TEXT / BINARY with LENGTH, or TEMPLATE: an empty document, the area's bytes unchanged, or the text the installed DOCTEMPLATE yields; LENGERR RESP2 1 for a negative LENGTH, NOTFND RESP2 3 for a template not installed) and DOCUMENT RETRIEVE (DOCTOKEN, INTO, LENGTH, MAXLENGTH, DATAONLY: at most MAXLENGTH bytes INTO, LENGTH the document's length, LENGERR RESP2 2 when truncated, NOTFND RESP2 1 for an unknown token, LENGERR RESP2 1 for a negative MAXLENGTH); the DOCTOKEN value, the installed templates' text, and the text a retrieved document's bytes are in are ours / stated by whoever runs the task; FROM, FROMDOC, SYMBOLLIST / LISTLENGTH / DELIMITER / UNESCAPED, DOCSIZE, HOSTCODEPAGE / CHARACTERSET, a RETRIEVE without DATAONLY or MAXLENGTH, a CREATE of TEXT / BINARY without LENGTH, a template with symbols or template commands, and DOCUMENT INSERT / SET / DELETE refused

INQUIRE URIMAP(name) with no browse option reads that definition among the installed ones the run states (X32's list: PATH and TRANSACTION as a browse NEXT returns them, NOTFND RESP2 3 when it is not installed, a browse in progress left where it was); INQUIRE PROGRAM STATUS answers ENABLED (CVDA 23), the DEFINE PROGRAM default, for every program the region defines, on NORMAL only; a case CSD defining a program STATUS(DISABLED) refused

The HTTP server is a stated fact (http_peers: scheme, host, port, CLIENT URIMAP and path, and the response to each request, matched by method, path and query in order); WEB OPEN by URIMAP or HOST / HOSTLENGTH / PORTNUMBER (80 / 443 when omitted) / SCHEME returns our 8-byte token (GGWSnnnn), LENGERR 21, INVREQ 40 / 138; WEB CONVERSE sends METHOD, PATH (the URIMAP's when omitted), QUERYSTRING, FROM with MEDIATYPE, recorded as a WEB-CONVERSE event, and returns INTO (at most MAXLENGTH, INTO's length when omitted; LENGERR 57 when longer), TOLENGTH, STATUSCODE, the reason phrase's bytes and MEDIATYPE (blank-padded to 56), with NOTOPEN 27, INVREQ 33 / 34 / 54 / 76, LENGERR 5 / 8 / 16 / 50 / 59; WEB CLOSE NOTOPEN 27; the exchange is in the program's characters (conversion options change nothing); refused: an unstated peer or response, two conditions at once, TRACE / OPTIONS, MAXLENGTH 0, no PATH on a HOST session, a blank MEDIATYPE with a body, a reason phrase longer than STATUSLEN, a length past its area, and every option zECS does not use

WEB PARSE URL is pure: URL / URLLENGTH are split into SCHEMENAME (upper case, blank-padded to its 16-byte area), HOST / HOSTLENGTH, PORTNUMBER (explicit, else 80 for HTTP and 443 for HTTPS), PATH / PATHLENGTH (with its leading slash) and QUERYSTRING / QUERYSTRLEN (without its question mark, still escaped); each length option is read as the area's size and set to the piece's length; INVREQ 28 (no scheme and ://, an empty scheme or host, a port that is not 1-5 digits or above 65535: ASSUMED) and INVREQ 65 (a percent not followed by two of 0-9 A-F); the areas are written on NORMAL only; refused: a scheme other than HTTP / HTTPS, user-info, a fragment, an IPv6 host, an empty port or port 0, a lowercase hex digit in an escape, a URLLENGTH not above zero or past its area, LENGERR (host / path / query longer than its length), a length past its area, a PATH or QUERYSTRING asked for when the URL has none, two conditions at once, HOSTTYPE

The task serves one inbound HTTP request that whoever runs it STATES (http_request: scheme, host, port, method, version, path, query, headers, media type and body; unstated, WEB SEND is refused); WEB SEND FROM / FROMLENGTH with ACTION(IMMEDIATE), MEDIATYPE, STATUSCODE (200 when omitted), STATUSTEXT / STATUSLEN (the whole area when STATUSLEN is omitted) and SRVCONVERT / NOSRVCONVERT is recorded as a WEB-SEND event (status, reason phrase or none, media type or none, body, action) and compared; INVREQ 11 (an action that is neither IMMEDIATE nor EVENTUAL) and INVREQ 72 (204 / 205 / 304 with a body); the response is in the program's characters (conversion changes nothing); refused: no stated request, ACTION EVENTUAL or omitted, a second send, FROMLENGTH or STATUSLEN not above zero, a length past its area, a STATUSCODE outside 100-599, a blank or malformed MEDIATYPE, SRVCONVERT on a media type that is not text/*, two conditions at once, and CONTAINER, CHANNEL, CHUNKING, CHARACTERSET, CLNTCODEPAGE, HOSTCODEPAGE, CLOSESTATUS, DOCSTATUS (what becomes of a sent document), LENGTH; WEB SEND DOCTOKEN sends the document the task created (DOCUMENT CREATE) as the body, an empty document being no body (a 204 may send it: ASSUMED), a token naming no document of the task refused

#4940: WEB READ FORMFIELD / QUERYPARM read the stated body form (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) / query string as name=value pairs joined by '&' (split at the first '=', only %XX unescaped), the name matched without case (IBM), two pairs of the name refused, NAMELENGTH / VALUELENGTH not above zero LENGERR RESP2 1, no data INVREQ RESP2 13, no such name NOTFND RESP2 1, a value longer than VALUELENGTH cut with LENGERR RESP2 5 and VALUELENGTH its real length; WEB STARTBROWSE / READNEXT / ENDBROWSE of HTTPHEADER, FORMFIELD, QUERYPARM keep a browse per kind (ILLOGIC RESP2 10 / 5 for a second start, INVREQ RESP2 43 / 13 for no headers / data, INVREQ RESP2 4 READNEXT / ENDBROWSE before a start, ENDFILE with RESP2 0 at the end, LENGERR RESP2 1 for a length not above zero with the browse left where it was, LENGERR RESP2 4 / 5 for a FORMFIELD / QUERYPARM name / value that does not fit, cut, the same pair returned again, lengths the real ones), a start name matched exactly (case-only or duplicate matches refused), a start that raises a condition starts no browse (ASSUMED); refused: SET, the code-page options, the client form (SESSTOKEN), HTTPHEADER truncation on READNEXT, a body that is not application/x-www-form-urlencoded, data with a pair lacking '=', an empty name or pair, ';', '+', a bad escape, an escaped name or a byte outside printable ASCII, a READNEXT after ENDFILE, a name and value both too long, two conditions at once. #4767: The task serves the one inbound HTTP request that whoever runs it STATES (http_request, as X37; unstated, each command is refused); WEB EXTRACT (server form) returns the stated scheme (CVDA HTTP 1096 / HTTPS 1029), host, HTTP method, HTTP version (the text the run states: ASSUMED), path, query string (none: length 0, area left alone: ASSUMED), the port and REQUESTTYPE HTTPYES, each length option read as the area's size and set to the piece's length, the areas written on NORMAL only; LENGERR RESP2 21 / 5 / 7 for a HOSTLENGTH / PATHLENGTH / VERSIONLEN not above zero; WEB RECEIVE INTO / LENGTH / MAXLENGTH / MEDIATYPE returns the stated body (cut at MAXLENGTH with LENGERR RESP2 57, LENGTH the bytes returned, LENGERR RESP2 16 for a MAXLENGTH not above zero, MEDIATYPE blank-padded to 56) with SRVCONVERT / NOSRVCONVERT changing nothing (program characters); WEB READ HTTPHEADER returns the value of the stated header of that exact name (INVREQ RESP2 43 no headers, NOTFND RESP2 1 no such header, LENGERR RESP2 1 VALUELENGTH not above zero); WEB WRITE HTTPHEADER adds a header to the response, recorded as WEB-HEADER and compared (a name written twice is two headers; LENGERR RESP2 35 / 55); refused: SET (the pointer lane), NOTRUNCATE, containers, every code-page option, SERVERCONV, BODYCHARSET, TYPE, the client forms (SESSTOKEN, REALM), HOSTTYPE, URIMAP, a LENGERR on a piece or value longer than its length, a METHODLENGTH / QUERYSTRLEN not above zero, a request with no body, a second RECEIVE, a header found only without case or stated twice, a header written after the response was sent, a name with a blank or colon, a length past its area, two conditions at once
